node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal facet-mixing obstruction
node.closure: exclusion of partition-preserving diagonal transport and an exact five-row crossing-orbit census
node.statement: For every actual diagonal-order-two component, the fixed-point-free endpoint involution tau must mix the invariant-coordinate six-set I with J=I^c. If c is the number of crossing labels then c is 2, 4, or 6, and the number a of tau-pairs inside the common five-set K together with the indicator b that I\K pairs into K has exactly five possible rows: (2,0,2), (1,1,2), (1,0,4), (0,1,4), (0,0,6). Whole-fiber K quartics have explicit support restrictions in J intersect tau(J) and J intersect tau(I). The aligned c=6 row is impossible; in the near-aligned c=6 survivor the four colored roots are exactly two complete reciprocal source fibers and the partial resultants descend to an exact quotient system. In c=2, the (2,0,2) row has exact degrees 4^4 on noncrossing J and 2^2 on crossing J, a forced square K fiber, and a fourth-power four-fiber product; the (1,1,2) row has analogous saturation except for one explicit near-aligned noncrossing-eta subcase. This deletes the partition-preserving and aligned c=6 subcases, not all mixing rows or the orientation.
